theorem putnam_1964_b2
(S : Type*) [Fintype S] [Nonempty S]
(P : Finset (Set S))
(hPP : ∀ T ∈ P, ∀ U ∈ P, T ∩ U ≠ ∅)
(hPS : ¬∃ T : Set S, T ∉ P ∧ (∀ U ∈ P, T ∩ U ≠ ∅))
: (P.card = 2 ^ (Fintype.card S - 1)) := by
  have hI : (P : Set (Set S)).Intersecting := fun _ hT _ hU hD =>
    hPP _ hT _ hU (Set.disjoint_iff_inter_eq_empty.mp hD)
  have hmax : ∀ t : Finset (Set S), (t : Set (Set S)).Intersecting → P ⊆ t → P = t := fun t ht hst =>
    le_antisymm hst fun a ha => Classical.byContradiction fun h =>
      hPS ⟨a, h, fun u hu hE => ht ha (hst hu) (Set.disjoint_iff_inter_eq_empty.mpr hE)⟩
  have h2 : 2 * P.card = 2 ^ Fintype.card S := (hI.is_max_iff_card_eq.mp hmax).trans Fintype.card_set
  have hp : 2 ^ (Fintype.card S - 1) * 2 = 2 ^ Fintype.card S := by
    rw [← Nat.pow_succ, Nat.succ_eq_add_one, Nat.sub_add_cancel Fintype.card_pos]
  omega
